Supreme Court Orders Enhanced Delhi Police Patrol for Women's Safety

The Supreme Court has directed the Delhi Police to increase patrolling and enhance measures for women's safety in the capital. The court ordered the verification of cab and bus drivers and the closure of specific establishments. These directives aim to address concerns regarding women's safety.
